summary_1line: Bhishma outlines proper duties of Brahmanas and other orders, emphasizing moral conduct, stages of life, and the central protective role of Kshatriya rule.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged king sits before the dying Bhishma on a bed of arrows as the warrior-sage instructs him about the duties of Brahmanas and kings.
A humble ascetic Brahmana in simple robes performs a Vedic rite beside a small fire, embodying purity and restraint.
A powerful Kshatriya king stands with sword lowered while priests and citizens gather behind him, symbolizing royal protection of social order.
